description: Defines the CookieOptions class and nested SameSiteCookieContext class, including enums and metadata related to cookie security contexts, cross-site considerations, and HTTP methods.

classes.name: CookieOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for cookie handling, including security context, HttpOnly exclusion, and first-party context.

classes.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext
classes.description: Represents the context for SameSite cookie policies, including trust levels and metadata about the context.

methods.name: CookieOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing cookie options with default settings.

methods.name: MakeAllInclusive
methods.description: Creates a CookieOptions instance configured to include all cookies, including HttpOnly and SameSite cookies.

methods.name: GetContextForCookieInclusion
methods.description: Returns the context type used for determining cookie inclusion.

methods.name: GetMetadataForCurrentSchemefulMode
methods.description: Returns metadata about the context considering the current schemeful mode.

methods.name: SetContextTypesForTesting
methods.description: Sets context types for testing purposes without consistency checks.

methods.name: CompleteEquivalenceForTesting
methods.description: Checks if two SameSiteCookieContext instances are completely equivalent, including metadata.
